infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NutriSnap uses your camera to photograph meals so it can estimate their nutrition.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NutriSnap needs access to your photos so you can log meals you already photographed.

plugins.cameraPermission: NutriSnap uses your camera to photograph meals so it can estimate their nutrition.

plugins.motionPermission: NutriSnap reads your step count while a walk or run is being tracked, to work out how far and how fast you went.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: NutriSnap reads your speed while a ride is running, so it can pick the right effort band for your calorie count.
